snippet.title: Mystics Ablaze - Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Gather Your Friends! 

Magi, spirits and occultists clash with colorful crystal orbs and explosive teleportation! Mystics Ablaze is a deep and spectacular couch fighting game for 2-4 players unlike anything you’ve ever played.

Wishlist on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3865560/Mystics_Ablaze/

Join our Discord: 
https://discord.gg/tgfMeuVxQS

Follow us on social media:
X (formerly Twitter): https://x.com/MysticsAblaze
Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/mysticsablaze/
Tumblr: http://mysticsablaze.tumblr.com/

By Coyote Time 🌠
